Professional Summary
DevOps and cloud-focused engineer with a strong foundation in infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations, combined with prior digital marketing experience. Experienced in designing and operating scalable AWS environments, automating deployments with Terraform and k8s-based workflows, and improving service observability.

- Rolled out Prometheus-based monitoring and alerting for core services on k8s, improving incident detection and mean time to recovery by measurable margins; used Prometheus, k8s, Linux.

Cloud Engineer, Razorpay (Jun 2023 - Jun 2025)
- Automated infrastructure lifecycles using Terraform to manage AWS accounts, VPCs, and EKS clusters, enabling repeatable environment creation and policy compliance; used Terraform, AWS.

- Operated and tuned Kubernetes clusters and node groups, applying Linux troubleshooting and Helm chart updates to improve reliability and resource utilization; used k8s, Helm, Linux.

Digital Marketing Manager, Ola (Feb 2021 - May 2023)
- Led SEO initiatives to improve organic search visibility for regional markets, driving measurable uplifts in organic sessions and keyword rankings through content and technical optimizations; used SEO.

- Collaborated with analytics and engineering teams to instrument landing pages and track performance, informing iterative optimizations across channels; used SEO, Google Ads.
